summary: Audit the proposed virtio-win 0.1.302 ISO and find GPL/LGPL, SPICE and MS-RL components without proven complete corresponding source. Remove the media from the 0.2.9 installer and retain the licensing evidence for any future bundling decision. API impact: none.

guide.reason: The VM guide now directs operators to import their own driver ISO because the public 0.2.9 installer does not bundle virtio-win.

api.reason: API impact: none. Removing an unaccounted build-time binary changes no Controller/Core or client-facing contract.

roadmap.reason: Automatic bundled-media delivery is open until complete corresponding source and notices are retained; second-driver-disc support remains complete.

state.reason: Build-time notice and manifest files persist no pool or Controller state.

verification.method: Listed the checksum-verified candidate ISO and recorded its embedded licenses. The installer regression check now rejects any virtio-win staging in the public build, and final 0.2.9 ISO inspection confirms it is absent. The Fedora src.rpm and exact SPICE source/license versions remain unverified, so automatic bundling remains open.
